chapter: Bands, leaders and radio of the thirties and forties
title: Stan King as second drummer in his orchestra
summary: Kline asks why Morehouse's orchestra had two drummers, himself and Stan King; he cannot say, and Hutto suggests the 14 N'goma drums.

bands.name: Chauncey Morehouse and his N'goma band

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You had a drummer when you had the orchestra, not your Swing Six but your orchestra, Stan King was your drummer.
Why did you need another drummer?
Stan King. Why didn't you play the drums?
Why did you need two drummers? Do you remember you had two, you had yourself and you also had Stan King.
Why do you suppose you had two drummers? There was yourself and another.
Were you pretty well surrounded by the 14 N'goma drums and professional drums? King probably.
